costs_scope_ck.name: costs_scope_ck
costs_scope_ck.value: "cost_entries"."battery_id" IS NOT NULL OR "cost_entries"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL

evidence_stored_consistent_ck.name: evidence_stored_consistent_ck
evidence_stored_consistent_ck.value:
"evidence_files"."storage_key" IS NULL
    OR ("evidence_files"."storage_key" = 'sha256/' || "evidence_files"."checksum" AND "evidence_files"."content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_files"."scan_status" IS NOT NULL)

attempts_reason_code_ck.name: attempts_reason_code_ck
attempts_reason_code_ck.value: "restoration_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'rework') OR "restoration_attempts"."decision_reason_code" IS NOT NULL

tests_level_target_ck.name: tests_level_target_ck
tests_level_target_ck.value:
("tests"."level" = 'battery' AND "tests"."battery_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tests"."string_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("tests"."level" = 'string' AND "tests"."string_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tests"."battery_id" IS NULL)

tests_separation_of_duties_ck.name: tests_separation_of_duties_ck
tests_separation_of_duties_ck.value:
"tests"."status" <> 'approved'
    OR ("tests"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tests"."reviewer_id" <> "tests"."operator_id" AND "tests"."reviewer_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "tests"."submitted_by_id")

tests_reason_code_ck.name: tests_reason_code_ck
tests_reason_code_ck.value: "tests"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'requires_rework') OR "tests"."review_reason_code" IS NOT NULL
